_comment: Reproducibility gate policy for scripts/repro_gate.py. Declares this corpus's adapter and its reproducibility ratchet. See repro_gate.py for the verdict vocabulary.

declared_exclusions.itlos/order/case34-order6-2026||2026-06-: Text recovered by dual-engine OCR (Tesseract + Google Cloud Vision) from the scanned ITLOS order and reconciled by hand; see the record's provenance_note. Google Vision is a network service, so the text is NOT re-derivable by committed, deterministic code. The byte-exact original.pdf and its recorded hash remain the authoritative anchor. This is an honest 'excluded', not a coverage gap — and it is why extract.py previously aborted here, taking the other 27 records' results down with it.
declared_exclusions.itlos/order/case34-order8-2026||2026-08-: Text recovered by two-engine OCR (Tesseract 5.5.0 + RapidOCR PP-OCRv4 ONNX) from a pure office-photocopier scan with NO text layer at all, reconciled by scripts/reconcile_itlos_orders.py; see the record's provenance_note. Excluded because reproduction needs the OCR toolchain (Tesseract binary + the pinned ONNX models), not committed deterministic code. NOTE, and it is a strict improvement on the sibling order6-2026 exclusion above: the second engine here is LOCAL and PINNED (rapidocr-onnxruntime 1.4.4 ships its ONNX models inside the wheel) rather than a network service, so this text IS re-derivable offline from a pinned toolchain — the exclusion reflects that the extractor is not part of scripts/, not that reproduction is impossible. The byte-exact original.pdf and its recorded hash remain the authoritative anchor.
declared_exclusions.itlos/order/case35-order9-2026||2026-08-: As itlos/order/case34-order8-2026 — same two-engine OCR of a pure photocopier scan, same reconciliation script, same local pinned second engine. See the record's provenance_note.
declared_exclusions.itlos/order/case34-order3-2026||2026-06-: Text recovered by two-engine OCR (Tesseract 5.5.0 + RapidOCR PP-OCRv4 ONNX) from an office-scanner image (Konica KM_4050i) that carries an Adobe Paper Capture VENDOR text layer. That layer was NOT adopted: it is a third, unversioned engine, it cannot be re-derived, and it is demonstrably wrong in it ('ING.' for 'INC.', 'heceinafter'). See the record's provenance_note for the adjudicated sites and the measured engine agreement (94.0% / 98.4% of characters, whitespace-insensitive). Excluded for the same reason as the sibling orders: reproduction needs the OCR toolchain, not committed deterministic code. The byte-exact original.pdf and its recorded hash remain the authoritative anchor.
declared_exclusions.itlos/order/case35-order4-2026||2026-06-: As itlos/order/case34-order3-2026 — the paired order in the parallel Case No. 35 proceeding, same scanner, same vendor layer, same two-engine reconciliation (99.1% / 99.0% of characters agree, whitespace-insensitive), same exclusion. See the record's provenance_note, which also records the 'TOML Registry' drafting slip retained as printed.
